name: duospace-background-geolocation
description: Local Capacitor plugin: native foreground-service (Android) / background CLLocationManager (iOS) location tracking that keeps running when the WebView is suspended, plus an immediate one-shot fix on demand (used when a call or message push arrives).
author: DuoSpace

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && rollup -c rollup.config.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run verify:ios && npm run verify:android
scripts.verify:ios: cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace Plugin.xcworkspace -scheme Plugin -destination generic/platform=iOS && cd ..
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
